The Devastator is time limited campaign. It take place in location New Guinea.

Text: "New weapons are revealed."

Time to complete: 72h

Number of mission: 5.

Enemy base HP : Shattered Sun 130

Enemy encounter:  [[Dragon]], [[Earthshaker]], [[Demon]], [[Halefire Humvee]], [[S.A.W.]], [[Ballista]].

Enemy equipment: Heavy Barrier, Incendiary Rounds, Reinforced Hull

Reward: [[Phoenix]]

During the event the [[Devastator Crate]] is available.
